text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle invited us out to play by a 
mountain stream. Meeting up with 
Matikanetannhauser, the three of us waited 
for the train—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Stream, mountain stream~! I can't wait~! 
Come to think of it, did you not invite 
anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Everyone was busy, so next time it is. I 
was feeling a bit down... but since you 
two are here, I am not lonely at all!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's great~. But next time, going 
camping with everyone sounds fun too! 
Tracen Academy has the "Summer Walk" 
event, after all.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That's right! Let's enjoy a fun event! 
Let's dance around the campfire!
choice_data_list: The "Summer Walk" is, if I recall...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
A summer event! Right? The academy does 
all sorts of big, exciting things so the 
students can refresh themselves~!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
They provide travel subsidies and 
everything! We'll get super refreshed with 
this!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer at Tracen Academy involves 
intensive training camps and is a crucial 
period for the Horse Girls. That is likely 
why such breathers are provided.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the train is here! Off to the stream 
we go! All aboard~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Finished changing! Waha~! The water is 
sparkling! Whoaaa~ it's so chilly~!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I watch over the two of them as they 
frolic like little children, splashing in 
the water and picking nuts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Come to think of it, Matikanetannhauser 
was troubled about hugging earlier. Did 
that get resolved?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The river feels so good! Oh! It's very 
slippery here!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hup!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! It's deeper here than other spots! 
It's dangerous!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hoh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...She's bracing herself to catch her. 
It's different from a hug, but is that 
part of her practice... or perhaps the 
result of it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A cute chirp... wait, what!? Th-This 
is bad! Look, over there!! A baby bird...! 
It might have fallen from its nest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
We need to help it quick... ah, but if we 
touch it and leave our scent, the mother 
bird won't come near, or so I heard 
somewhere—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! Poor thing! I'll return it to its 
house right now!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah, Taiki-san!?
choice_data_list: It's dangerous, let me do it!
It's dangerous, let me do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could stop her, Taiki Shuttle 
scooped up the chick and began climbing 
the tree.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It went smoothly at first, but halfway up, 
Taiki Shuttle seemed to lose sight of her 
footholds and stopped moving.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh...! Because I'm hugging the baby, I 
cannot check my footing...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Kh. Just stay still!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
From where your feet are now to the next 
foothold... the stable one is... Ah, is 
that branch rotten...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then over this way... somewhere your toes 
can hook firmly... yeah, judging by the 
diameter, that hollow looks deeper. And 
then...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Alright, got it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Move your left foot about 12 cm diagonally 
down to the right! You'll step down for a 
moment, but you'll be fine. Once you move 
it, next take your right foot—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Guided by Matikanetannhauser's precise 
instructions, Taiki Shuttle safely climbs 
up to the nest. And then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Goal! Thank you, Tannhauser! The 
baby is back home!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ! Yay...! That's great, Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the mother bird came back too...! She 
was watching from nearby. Thank goodness, 
looks like everything's okay!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew... What a reli... OH!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ! Taiki-san!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Taiki Shuttle starts to slip, 
Matikanetannhauser, having climbed up in 
an instant, catches and supports her. 
Then, they carefully make their way back 
down—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser, thank you so much...! I was 
really surprised—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Are you hurt!? That was so scary, wasn't 
it!? Uwaaahh, I'm so glad you're okaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser hugs Taiki Shuttle 
tightly. Her overwhelming worry must have 
overflowed.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uuu, I'm so glad...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser...! Mm~! Your concern feels so 
warm! I am very, very happy!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I feel so much love in your concern, yes! 
So, sorry and thank you!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(...I see. That's love too. Caring for 
someone, worrying about them, trying to 
help. Does that mean I managed to get it 
across properly?)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
E-Ehehehe... I get it now. Expressions of 
love come in all shapes and sizes, don't 
they?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, thank you too! You kept your 
arms wide open below the whole time!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not only had I failed to stop them, I 
hadn't been of any help at all, so I'd 
hoped they wouldn't notice, but...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ! Love, that's love too, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
YES! Love and peace! Let's all hug 
together, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unable to withstand the tackle... er, hug 
from the two horse girls, water from the 
river splashed up all around us.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, so sorry too! We made you 
worry so much...! Here's a reassuring hug!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, are you blushing? You're definitely 
blushing! See, we really do need hug 
practice after all!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hug practice? Yeah! Leave it to me! I'll 
give you plenty of hugs!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tried to deny it, but I felt completely 
powerless against the two of them smiling 
ear to ear...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, so sorry. We made you worry 
so much...
choice_data_list: I'm just glad you're both safe...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still, I told them not to do anything 
dangerous again. Just imagining what could 
have happened made my heart ache.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That's right! I was really worried, jeez!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You too," I muttered, letting out a deep 
sigh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"You too," I muttered, letting out a deep 
sigh.
